integrity.proof_basis: Explicit register normal form, exhaustive classification of two- and three-mixed-fibre obstructions, and symbolic labelled enumeration.
integrity.reproducibility: checker.py; standalone Python standard library; enumeration is diagnostic and not a substitute for the general proof.
integrity.scope: Only the claims in RESULT.md under the stated alphabet, team and lax-splitting assumptions.

scientific_limitations: The result assumes two available values for x and teams of distinct triples with exactly the variables x,y,z.
No comparable bound is claimed for three or more values of x; unbounded-domain incoherence is known.
Labelled enumerations are not isomorphism-class counts, and independent external validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp six-tuple obstruction theorem for a binary determinant in dependence logic
